strings.en:
{1c:11}{0b:08}【 Qumran 】{0b:09}
It is an odd thing to rejoice at being
called Devils,{1a}but the line between good and evil may
be a vague thing after all, shifting in any
direction depending on one's way of
thinking and of seeing.{1a}{0c:524850}At any rate, there is no doubt that the
battles ahead will be fiercer than
any before.{1a}Angels and the Thirteen Saints are
among the greatest beings humans have
created in their hearts.{1a}They are not ancient gods like those we
have fought so far. They are living
objects of faith, worshipped by the
people to this day.{1a}Given that the strength of people's
minds affects how monsters take form,
their power will be beyond comparison
with the monsters we have fought{1a}until now.{1a}{0c:5140}Angels are God's mighty vanguard, who
cast a multitude of devils out of
His paradise,{1a}and the Thirteen Saints are the humans
closest to God after the Prophet Anoia.
So the Scriptures say.{1a}Whether these tales in the Scriptures
are fact or fiction does not
matter now...{1a}{0c:524850}What weighs more is the fact that the
Anoians, 99% of the world, believe it so.{0c:fe}

strings.en:
{1c:11}{0b:08}【 Qumran 】{0b:09}
Monsters appearing, nations collapsing,
natural disasters, endless war... People
the world over are at their limit.{1a}Amid all this, they seek peace of mind in
'faith' in the Anoian religion.{1a}{0c:524850}Faith itself is no bad thing. And since
the angels are defeating monsters, I
suppose it should be welcomed.{1a}{0c:2348513054522000}But given that the strength of people's
faith affects how monsters take form, I
cannot rejoice without reservation.{1a}Thanks to the angels' miracles, occurring
one after another all over the world, we
can be certain the angels in the labyrinth
have gained still more power.{0c:fe}
strings.tl: Monsters appearing, nations collapsing, natural disasters, endless war... People the world over are at their limit. // Amid all this, they seek peace of mind in 'faith' in the Anoian religion. // [1]Faith itself is no bad thing. And since the angels are defeating monsters, I suppose it should be welcomed. // [2]But given that the strength of people's faith affects how monsters take form, I cannot rejoice without reservation. // Thanks to the angels' miracles, occurring one after another all over the world, we can be certain the angels in the labyrinth have gained still more power.
Right... Guess that's how it is... // Tch, I'd like to tell everyone in the world not to believe what's happenin' right in front of 'em.

In our crew, the only ones that dutiful to God are Luca and Arthur, right?
I am all right. Hearing Qumran-san has put my doubts to rest. I will fight.
So I guess the one in the most danger is Luca...

そう教えこまれてきたという
事実の方が重大です。{0c:fe}

strings.en:
Please be careful.{1a}{0c:524850}Angels and Saints are among the
greatest beings humans have created in
their hearts.{1a}They are not ancient gods like those we
have fought so far. Angels and Saints
alike are living objects of faith,
worshipped by the people to this day.{1a}Given that the strength of people's
minds affects how monsters take form,
their power will be beyond comparison
with the monsters we have fought{1a}until now.{1a}{0c:5140}Angels are God's mighty vanguard, who
cast a multitude of devils out of
His paradise,{1a}and the Thirteen Saints are the humans
closest to God after the Prophet Anoia.
So the Scriptures say.{1a}Whether these tales are fact or fiction
does not matter...{1a}{0c:524850}What weighs more is the fact that the
Anoians, 99% of the world, have been
taught it so.{0c:fe}
strings.tl: Please be careful. // [1]Angels and Saints are among the greatest beings humans have created in their hearts. // They are not ancient gods like those we have fought so far. Angels and Saints alike are living objects of faith, worshipped by the people to this day. // Given that the strength of people's minds affects how monsters take form, their power will be beyond comparison with the monsters we have fought until now. // [2]Angels are God's mighty vanguard, who cast a multitude of devils out of His paradise, // and the Thirteen Saints are the humans closest to God after the Prophet Anoia. So the Scriptures say. // Whether these tales are fact or fiction does not matter... // [3]What weighs more is the fact that the Anoians, 99% of the world, have been taught it so.
